sections.h2: A painting contractor that works the southeast corner of Alachua County
body: Hawthorne sits on the southeast side of Alachua County, where lake country and highway frontage share the same zip code. As painters in Hawthorne, FL, we split our time between two very different kinds of houses: the older homes near Lochloosa and Orange Lake, and the newer construction that has gone up along SR-20. They fail in different ways, so we do not price or prep them the same way.

We are locally owned and based in Newberry, with more than 15 years of painting experience. We are licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, workers' comp covers every person on the crew, and we do not hand jobs to subcontractors. The crew lead who measures your house is part of the team that paints it.

sections.h2: Two housing eras, two prep plans
body: Around Lochloosa, Johnson Lake, and Little Orange Creek, many homes have decades of paint history on them. Wood trim has been recoated more times than anyone remembers, window sills hold soft spots, and the bottom edge of fascia is usually the first thing to go. On these homes the bulk of the labor is scraping back to a sound edge, cutting out rot, re-caulking open joints, and spot-priming bare wood before a single topcoat goes on.

Newer homes along SR-20 and around Downtown Hawthorne tend to have the opposite problem: the substrate is fine, but the original builder coat is thin. Flat interior walls scuff the first time someone moves a couch, and exterior color starts to chalk early. Here the work is mostly a thorough wash, a bonding primer where needed, and two full coats of a premium acrylic that actually builds film.

sections.h2: What lake air and summer storms do to a paint job here
body: Summer humidity in Hawthorne stays above 75 percent for months, and from June into September afternoon storms roll through three or four days a week. Walls that sit in the shade of oaks or face the lake stay damp long enough to grow mildew, while south- and west-facing walls lose pigment to UV. A good plan treats those elevations differently, so our estimates note moisture readings and sun exposure side by side.

For the exterior we schedule the heavy work between October and May when we can. Summer exteriors are still possible, but crews start early and watch dew point and radar before opening a can. Interior work can run in any month.

sections.h2: Services we bring to Hawthorne properties
body: Most calls start with one surface and grow from there. Homeowners often begin with repainting the outside of the house, usually after soft washing the mildewed siding, then add a deck re-stain or fence painting and staining. Inside, we handle walls, ceilings, and trim, tired oak kitchens through cabinet refinishing in Hawthorne, and palette decisions through a local color consultation. Shop owners along SR-20 can read about commercial repaints scheduled around business hours. Homeowners planning both halves of the house should see residential painting for Hawthorne homes, and the full Hawthorne service overview lists everything else.

sections.h2: How a Hawthorne project moves from walkthrough to punch list
body: Walkthroughs are usually set within 48 hours of your call. A crew lead measures, photographs conditions, and takes moisture readings on anything questionable. The itemized estimate normally follows within one business day and spells out surfaces included and excluded, prep, primer and topcoat by product line, number of coats, and the schedule. Nothing gets added without your written approval.

Most jobs begin one to three weeks after you sign. Prep days come first: washing, scraping, sanding, mildew treatment, rot and fascia replacement, caulking, and spot-priming. Then application, then a punch walk that you sign. If something is not right at that walk, we fix it before closing the job, and we leave labelled touch-up paint behind.
Hawthorne is one stop on a regular route through Alachua County. We also paint in Micanopy, Gainesville, and our home base of Newberry, so scheduling a walkthrough out your way is rarely a problem.

faqs.q: Do you paint older homes near Lochloosa and Orange Lake?
faqs.a: Yes. Those homes are a large share of our Hawthorne work. Expect more prep time for scraping, rot repair, and spot-priming than a newer house would need, and expect all of it to be listed on the estimate.

faqs.q: How soon can you walk a property in Hawthorne?
faqs.a: Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and the written estimate typically arrives within one business day after that.

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured for work in Hawthorne?
faqs.a: We are licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida with workers' comp on every crew member. If an HOA or business needs proof, a certificate naming that entity can be issued ahead of the start date.

faqs.q: Do I have to leave the house while you paint inside?
faqs.a: No. Crews move and protect furniture and work one room at a time, so you can stay home throughout.
